name: Hashrate expansion + non-stretched funding — btc_hashrate cross-up on a momentum BTC/ETH long
rationale: Thesis: a hashrate-confirmed uptrend (miner conviction) is safest to ride when perp funding is NOT already stretched-positive — high funding means the long side is crowded and prone to a long-squeeze that would stop us out despite the on-chain backing. funding_rate is BOUNDED (~±0.01) so a fitted ceiling binds (require funding BELOW a not-crowded level); btc_hashrate drifts so it enters ONLY as a cross_up; positive momentum confirms the trend. Disconfirmer 1: drop the funding<fund_ceil gate and keep hashrate cross + momentum — if the deflated Sharpe holds, the funding (crowding) filter is inert. Disconfirmer 2: replace the hashrate cross_up with a permuted-lag copy — if the Sharpe is unchanged, miner-conviction timing is not the driver. BTC/ETH, long-only spot, funding read for context only (funding_feature stays null — spot, no funding paid).
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up while funding is non-crowded and BTC/ETH momentum is positive
